entities.summary: Kalpana Morparia is an Indian banker. She was associated with ICICI Bank for thirty three years. She was the chief executive officer of South and Southeast Asia, JPMorgan, the Indian extension of a 2.1 trillion dollar American company. Kalpana serves as an independent Director on the Boards of several leading Indian companies. A graduate in law from Bombay University, Morparia has served on several committees constituted by the Government of India. She is ranked by Fortune magazine as one of the fifty most powerful women in international business. Kalpana Morparia was a performers & entertainers from India (b. 1949). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
